input._script:
using JSON3, CUDA
res = Dict{String,Any}("device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())), "julia" => string(VERSION), "cuda" => string(CUDA.runtime_version()))
oneline(e, n) = replace(first(sprint(showerror, e), n), "\n" => " ¦ ")
M = Module(:MP)
Core.eval(M, :(using JACC, CUDA))
res["jacc_version"] = try string(pkgversion(M.JACC)) catch e; "?" end
res["backend"] = try string(M.JACC.default_backend()) catch e; "?" end
# the lines of the JACC CUDA extension that name a stream or a sync
try
    ext = Base.get_extension(M.JACC, :JACCCUDAExt)
    ls = String[]
    for f in readdir(dirname(pathof(ext)); join = true)
        endswith(f, ".jl") || continue
        for (k, l) in enumerate(eachline(f))
            occursin(r"sync|stream|launch_spec|LaunchSpec", l) && length(ls) < 60 && push!(ls, basename(f) * ":" * string(k) * ": " * strip(l)[1:min(end, 150)])
        end
    end
    res["ext_lines"] = ls
catch e
    res["ext_lines"] = oneline(e, 300)
end
Base.include_string(M, """
function slow!(i, x, n)
    s = 0.0
    for k in 1:n
        s += sin(k * 1.0e-3 + i)
    end
    @inbounds x[i] = (s == 12345.678) ? 0.0 : 1.0
    return nothing
end
function slowread!(i, x, out, n)
    s = 0.0
    for k in 1:n
        s += sin(k * 1.0e-3 + i)
    end
    @inbounds out[i] = x[i] + (s == 12345.678 ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    return nothing
end
function plus1!(i, x, y)
    @inbounds y[i] = x[i] + 1.0
    return nothing
end
launch_slow(x, N, n) = JACC.@parallel_for range = N sync = false slow!(x, n)
launch_slowread(x, out, N, n) = JACC.@parallel_for range = N sync = false slowread!(x, out, n)
launch_plus1(x, y, N) = JACC.@parallel_for range = N sync = false plus1!(x, y)
red_sum(x, N) = JACC.@parallel_reduce range = N (((i, x) -> x[i]))(x)
""")
N = 1 << 16
dev(v) = M.JACC.array(v)
# time of a launch return against time of completion, to show the launch is asynchronous
let x = dev(zeros(N))
    M.launch_slow(x, N, 20000); CUDA.synchronize()
    t0 = time_ns(); M.launch_slow(x, N, 20000); t1 = time_ns(); CUDA.synchronize(); t2 = time_ns()
    res["launch_return_ms"] = (t1 - t0) / 1e6; res["completion_ms"] = (t2 - t0) / 1e6
end
nreps = 12
n = 20000
function trial(name, f)
    bad = 0; err = nothing
    for r in 1:nreps
        try
            f() || (bad += 1)
        catch e
            err = oneline(e, 300); bad += 1
        end
        CUDA.synchronize()
    end
    res["case_" * name] = Dict("failures" => bad, "of" => nreps, "error" => err)
end
fresh() = dev(zeros(N))
trial("to_host", () -> (x = fresh(); M.launch_slow(x, N, n); all(==(1.0), M.JACC.to_host(x))))
trial("Array", () -> (x = fresh(); M.launch_slow(x, N, n); all(==(1.0), Array(x))))
trial("Vector_of_to_host", () -> (x = fresh(); M.launch_slow(x, N, n); all(==(1.0), Vector{Float64}(M.JACC.to_host(x)))))
trial("allowscalar_read_first", () -> (x = fresh(); M.launch_slow(x, N, n); CUDA.@allowscalar(x[1] == 1.0)))
trial("allowscalar_read_last", () -> (x = fresh(); M.launch_slow(x, N, n); CUDA.@allowscalar(x[N] == 1.0)))
trial("parallel_reduce", () -> (x = fresh(); M.launch_slow(x, N, n); M.red_sum(x, N) == N))
trial("second_async_kernel", () -> (x = fresh(); y = fresh(); M.launch_slow(x, N, n); M.launch_plus1(x, y, N); all(==(2.0), M.JACC.to_host(y))))
trial("host_scalar_write_after", () -> (x = fresh(); M.launch_slow(x, N, n); CUDA.@allowscalar(x[1] = 5.0); CUDA.synchronize(); CUDA.@allowscalar(x[1]) == 5.0))
trial("host_scalar_write_before_read", () -> (x = fresh(); CUDA.@allowscalar(x[3] = 4.0); M.launch_slowread(x, fresh(), N, n); true))
# a kernel reads x after a long loop, x is freed on the host right away (cgen_free_scratch), a new array is allocated and filled
trial("unsafe_free_then_realloc", () -> (x = dev(fill(2.0, N)); out = fresh(); M.launch_slowread(x, out, N, n); CUDA.unsafe_free!(x); z = dev(fill(7.0, N)); w = CUDA.fill(9.0, N); all(==(2.0), M.JACC.to_host(out))))
trial("JACC_zeros_then_kernel", () -> (x = fresh(); M.launch_slow(x, N, n); z = M.JACC.zeros(Float64, N); M.launch_plus1(x, z, N); all(==(2.0), M.JACC.to_host(z))))
trial("JACC_array_h2d_after", () -> (x = fresh(); M.launch_slow(x, N, n); h = dev(fill(3.0, N)); M.launch_plus1(h, x, N); all(==(4.0), M.JACC.to_host(x))))
# the documented limit: a read in another task uses that task's stream
trial("read_in_other_task_NO_SYNC", () -> (x = fresh(); M.launch_slow(x, N, n); fetch(Threads.@spawn all(==(1.0), Array(x)))))
trial("read_in_other_task_after_sync", () -> (x = fresh(); M.launch_slow(x, N, n); CUDA.synchronize(); fetch(Threads.@spawn all(==(1.0), Array(x)))))
println(JSON3.write(res))
